required_consumer_behavior: Render decision, intent, execution, acknowledgement and readback as distinct receipt evidence and navigate lineage by predecessor receipt IDs.
Never label intent or provider acknowledgement as completed/read-back effect.
Consume service/dependency/runbook metadata from GET /api/v1/catalog while treating UNVERIFIED_CONSUMER and null lastObservedReleaseSha literally.
Return a versioned UI service descriptor rather than requiring the API to guess UI runtime metadata.
known_limitations: Durable universal receipt storage is not activated.
The producer has not inspected the UI repository.
No production release SHA, SLO or dashboard is claimed.
